diagnostics.MC_split_interpretation: Two independent sets of 16 latent samples at each identical input; model-side sampling variability only, not data uncertainty or confidence intervals.

sliced_W1.interpretation: Finite deterministic directions in raw (x,y) units; not full multivariate Wasserstein distance

joint.bandwidth_method: Median Euclidean distance of 200000 sampled distinct-index pairs in data-standardized coordinates
joint.feature: sqrt(2) cos(omega dot standardized_coordinate + phase); MMD2 = mean squared mean-feature discrepancy
joint.interpretation: Independent diagnostic features; not comparable numerically to original training MM loss. MC split measures only latent-sampling noise conditional on this fixed validation sequence.

residual.bandwidth_method: Median Euclidean distance of 200000 sampled distinct-index pairs in data-standardized coordinates
residual.feature: sqrt(2) cos(omega dot standardized_coordinate + phase); MMD2 = mean squared mean-feature discrepancy
residual.interpretation: Independent diagnostic features; not comparable numerically to original training MM loss. MC split measures only latent-sampling noise conditional on this fixed validation sequence.

limitations: Validation pairs are temporally dependent; no iid uncertainty or significance claim.
Conditional bins mix nearby inputs and sparse bins have limited data support.
Finite-direction sliced W1 and finite-feature MMD do not prove equality of full joint laws.
Near-diagonal raw joint geometry can conceal transition errors; residual diagnostics are reported separately.
Latent MC split measures model-side sampling variability conditional on this dataset only.
This validation set was monitored during retraining; it is not a never-used test set.
